headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of August 13, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 27.09% compared to SPY's 14.80%. This results in an average alpha of 12.30%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered an impressive return of 50.90%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 17.19%, still above the benchmark but less impactful. This relative strength against SPY is particularly noteworthy during periods of market uncertainty, highlighting the portfolio's resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
